data: What is the range of the number of authors presented in the first plot?

The first plot shows the F1 scores for different models (CNN-char, SCAP, CNN-word-word-char, and CNN-word-char) as the number of authors increases. The x-axis represents the number of authors, ranging from approximately 10 to 150. The y-axis represents the F1 score, which ranges from approximately 60 to 95. Therefore, the range of the number of authors presented in the first plot is approximately 10 to 150.
